{{Scorpio}}
Scorpio 5 is the 313th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 5th day of Scorpio, and it is a Friday. It corresponds to ISO week 45, weekday 5.

Its informal Japanese name is 12宮5日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 313|Chapter 313]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152332}}.
